claims.text: Oral phosphate: Ca < 11.5 mg/dL w mild Sx and no kidney dz
claims.quote: Oral phosphate for serum calcium < 11.5 mg/dL (< 2.9 mmol/L) with mild symptoms and no kidney disease

claims.text: Chloroquine (sarcoidosis): lowers Ca; retinal exams every 6 to 12 months
claims.quote: Chloroquine phosphate, 500 mg orally once a day, inhibits 1,25(OH)2D synthesis and reduces serum calcium concentration in patients with sarcoidosis. Routine ophthalmologic surveillance (eg, retinal examinations every 6 to 12 months) is mandatory to detect dose-related retinal damage.
